verdict.rationale: Docs show card creation (virtual/physical) plus authorization rules and spend limits that can be scoped to card level, merchant category, and velocity/amount, which supports tight per-card restrictions (lithic-docs-9, lithic-docs-3, lithic-docs-13, lithic-docs-11). However, no explicit documentation of a 'single-use' card type or automatic one-time-use invalidation is present, only generic spend/authorization controls. Missing for 10: explicit single-use card mechanism, explicit exact-amount lock enforcement, and independent/hands-on confirmation that a leaked card number becomes unusable after one transaction.
